title: A Data-Driven Trade Forecasting Framework for Industrial Chemical Imports: Evidence from Vietnam's Sodium Hydroxide Market

detail.title: A Data-Driven Trade Forecasting Framework for Industrial Chemical Imports: Evidence from Vietnam's Sodium Hydroxide Market

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Title:  A Data-Driven Trade Forecasting Framework for Industrial Chemical Imports: Evidence from Vietnam's Sodium Hydroxide Market
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20141783
Publisher/Repository: Zenodo
Date: 05/12/2026

detail.abstract: This study develops an integrated Business Intelligence (BI) and econometric framework for forecasting industrial chemical imports, validated through the case of Vietnam's Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) market (HS Code 28151200). Utilizing a high-frequency dataset of 1,993 customs transactions spanning December 2024 to April 2025-capturing 113,466 metric tons of NaOH valued at USD 41.4 million across 146 importers and 108 exporters-the research synthesizes transaction-level trade records with macroeconomic drivers including Vietnam's Industrial Production Index (IPI), GDP growth, VND/USD exchange rate and global caustic soda price benchmarks. A hybrid forecasting architecture combining log-linear structural demand estimation, Seasonal ARIMA and Vector Autoregression (VAR) is developed and validated. The proposed framework achieves a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 6.2%, substantially outperforming traditional ARIMA (12.4%) and OLS (10.8%) benchmarks. VAR impulse response analysis confirms a statistically significant negative response of import volumes to exchange rate shocks, with a trough at Month 3 and an IPI spillover effect persisting for six months. The study makes three original contributions: (1) the first application of transaction-level customs data to econometric NaOH import demand modeling in Vietnam; (2) a validated hybrid ARIMA-VAR forecasting architecture; and (3) a replicable BI operationalization framework translating econometric outputs into procurement decision support. Results demonstrate that IPI and downstream industrial output are the dominant demand drivers, with a short-run price elasticity of-0.41 and exchange rate elasticity of-0.32. The framework is scalable to other HS-coded industrial inputs across emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个集成商业智能（BI）与计量经济学的预测框架，用于预测工业化学品进口需求，并以越南氢氧化钠（NaOH）市场为例进行验证。通过分析1993条海关交易数据，结合宏观经济变量，构建了混合预测架构（Log-linear + SARIMA + VAR），实现了6.2%的MAPE，优于传统模型。研究发现工业产出是主要需求驱动因素，汇率冲击对进口量有显著负向影响。
AI.research_question: 如何利用交易级海关数据与宏观经济变量，构建一个高精度的混合预测框架，以预测工业化学品的进口需求？
AI.motivation: 工业化学品进口预测对供应链管理和采购决策至关重要，但现有方法多依赖宏观时间序列数据，忽略了微观交易层面的信息。同时，传统的单一预测模型（如ARIMA、OLS）精度有限。因此，需要开发一个整合微观交易数据与宏观驱动因素的混合预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求弹性理论（价格弹性、汇率弹性）、时间序列分析（ARIMA）、向量自回归（VAR）模型、商业智能（BI）决策支持框架。
AI.method: 采用混合预测架构：1）对数线性结构需求估计；2）季节性ARIMA模型；3）向量自回归（VAR）模型。数据来源包括1993条越南海关交易记录（2024年12月至2025年4月）及宏观经济指标（IPI、GDP、汇率、全球价格基准）。通过MAPE比较评估模型性能。
AI.findings: 1）混合框架MAPE为6.2%，优于ARIMA（12.4%）和OLS（10.8%）；2）VAR脉冲响应分析显示，汇率冲击在第3个月对进口量产生显著负向响应，IPI溢出效应持续6个月；3）短期价格弹性为-0.41，汇率弹性为-0.32；4）IPI和下游工业产出是主导需求驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次将交易级海关数据应用于越南NaOH进口需求的计量经济学建模，填补了该领域实证空白；2）验证了混合ARIMA-VAR预测架构的有效性，为时间序列预测方法提供了新的组合路径；3）提出了可复制的BI操作化框架，将计量经济学输出转化为采购决策支持，打通了理论与应用的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为越南及新兴市场的工业化学品进口商提供了高精度的需求预测工具，有助于优化库存管理和采购策略；2）框架具有可扩展性，可推广至其他HS编码的工业投入品及新兴市场国家；3）揭示了汇率和工业产出对进口需求的具体影响机制，为企业的风险管理与政府政策制定提供了量化依据。

title: The Heterogeneity Imperative: AI, Machine Learning, Conjoint Analysis, and the Unfinished Agenda of Wagner Kamakura
affiliations: Independant and Rice University

detail.title: The Heterogeneity Imperative: AI, Machine Learning, Conjoint Analysis, and the Unfinished Agenda of Wagner Kamakura

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author Yang Wang is an employee of Amazon; however, this chapter is unaffiliated with any work at Amazon.

detail.abstract: This chapter evaluates the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) on conjoint analysis through the lens of Wagner Kamakura’s "heterogeneity imperative." While AI/ML methods often match population averages, they frequently fail to uncover the underlying structure of consumer heterogeneity—defined here as taste, structural, and concomitant variable differences. The authors assess four key applications: machine-learning-driven adaptive design and generative product design (which respect heterogeneity), large language model (LLM) synthetic respondents (which destroy it via "flattening" and stereotyping), and deep-learning flexible utility estimation (which partially recovers it). To address these methodological risks, the chapter proposes a validation framework based on the concomitant variable model—the  coefficient test—to ensure that synthetic data preserves the joint mapping between covariates and preferences essential for effective market segmentation and targeting.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Kamakura的"异质性法则"，评估AI/ML对联合分析的影响，发现LLM合成受访者会破坏消费者异质性，并提出基于伴随变量模型的验证框架来确保合成数据保留偏好异质性结构。
AI.research_question: AI和机器学习方法如何在联合分析中影响对消费者异质性的捕捉与还原？
AI.motivation: AI/ML方法虽然能匹配总体均值，但常常无法揭示消费者异质性的底层结构（品味差异、结构差异、伴随变量差异），这对市场细分和精准定位构成方法论风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kamakura的"异质性法则"（heterogeneity imperative）；伴随变量模型（concomitant variable model）
AI.method: 评估四种AI/ML应用：机器学习驱动的自适应设计与生成式产品设计（尊重异质性）、大语言模型合成受访者（破坏异质性）、深度学习灵活效用估计（部分恢复异质性）；提出基于伴随变量模型的β系数检验验证框架。
AI.findings: LLM合成受访者通过"扁平化"和刻板印象破坏了异质性；自适应设计和生成式设计较好地保留了异质性；深度学习方法能部分恢复异质性；伴随变量模型可作为验证合成数据是否保留偏好结构的有效工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kamakura的异质性法则系统性地应用到AI/ML联合分析的方法论评估中，明确了不同AI方法对异质性的不同影响机制，并提出了可操作的验证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用AI/ML进行联合分析的从业者提供了评估合成数据质量的β系数检验方法，帮助确保市场细分和定位策略的有效性。

title: The Demand Factor in the Age of AI: Fiscal Principle, Measurement Architecture, and Financing Horizon
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Demand Factor in the Age of AI: Fiscal Principle, Measurement Architecture, and Financing Horizon
detail.abstract: This document is a conceptual and programmatic Discussion Paper, not a conventional academic article nor a closed technical proposal. Its purpose is to mark out a direction of research: to formulate an architecture for thinking about the relationship between artificial intelligence, effective demand, taxation, measurement, distribution, and financing. Formal propositions, quantitative calibration, rigorous modeling, legal codification, and empirical validation are deliberately beyond the scope of this text. They are not omitted because they are secondary, but because they belong to a later stage of the IRIS program-one that will require economists, jurists, public administrations, measurement specialists, AI experts, and technical experts capable of converting structural intuitions into verifiable designs. The contribution offered here is of a different kind: to order the problem, identify its levels, and propose categories capable of guiding further work. MAT, MAR, and MAD are presented as conceptual instruments and institutional directions. Their tax bases, rates, credits, thresholds, settlement procedures, appeal mechanisms, and forms of governance remain open to research, democratic deliberation, and institutional calibration. Any figures or orders of magnitude that appear in the text should be read as illustrative references. They are not definitive design parameters. They are intended to show the structural scale of the problem, not to close an implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性、纲领性的讨论文件，提出IRIS研究框架，旨在构建关于人工智能、有效需求、税收、测量、分配与融资之间关系的分析架构。文中提出MAT、MAR、MAD三个概念工具和制度方向，但明确将形式化建模、定量校准和法律编纂等工作留待后续阶段。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够系统性地思考人工智能、有效需求、税收、测量、分配与融资之间关系的分析架构？
AI.motivation: 人工智能的发展将对经济体系产生深远影响，但现有研究缺乏一个整合性的框架来系统思考AI与有效需求、税收、分配和融资之间的多重关系。需要先厘清问题的层次和类别，为后续的严格研究奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出了三个概念工具和制度方向：MAT、MAR、MAD（文中未展开具体定义），作为引导后续研究的分析范畴。文章采用问题排序和层级识别的方法论立场，而非提供封闭的技术方案。
AI.method: 概念分析与纲领性论述。通过问题排序（ordering the problem）、层级识别（identifying its levels）和范畴建构（proposing categories）的方法，提出分析架构。
AI.findings: 本文本身不提供实证或形式化发现，而是提出了一个研究纲领：MAT、MAR、MAD作为概念工具和制度方向，其税基、税率、抵免、门槛、结算程序、上诉机制和治理形式等均留待后续研究、民主协商和制度校准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合AI、有效需求、税收、测量、分配与融资的分析架构雏形；创建了MAT、MAR、MAD三个概念范畴以组织后续研究；明确了问题层次和类别，为跨学科研究提供了共同的概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家、法学家、公共行政人员、测量专家、AI专家和技术专家提供了一个共同的研究方向和对话框架；指出了需要民主协商和制度校准的开放领域，而非过早关闭实现方案。

title: Generation–Verification Asymmetry Inversion and Apprenticeship Pipeline Collapse Under AI Substitution
affiliations: GenAI Architect; Independent Researcher

detail.title: Generation–Verification Asymmetry Inversion and Apprenticeship Pipeline Collapse Under AI Substitution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical contribution based exclusively on publicly available labor-economics statistics and standard published literature; it does not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, animal subjects, or any data requiring institutional ethics review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted by the author independently.

detail.abstract: For most of economic history, generation has been costly and verification cheap; tacit-capital institutions were optimized for that asymmetry. AI inverts the cost structure: generation becomes near-free while verification remains a Polanyi residual that is tacit and labor-intensive. We develop a tacit-capital production model with CES output in generation and verification, AI substitution at rate θ, and verification capacity acquired only through accumulated generation experience under h(τ)=τ^a. Two phenomena follow. The asymmetry inversion is a smooth equilibrium transition at θ_inv where the binding factor switches; markets handle it. The apprenticeship pipeline collapse is a phase transition at θ* = 1 − τ*/T_j where no cohort meets the promotion threshold; the steady-state verification stock undergoes a downward jump of ν T_s (τ*)^a and decays linearly to zero over the senior career length T_s with no market-mediated recovery. The credentialing return decays at rate a+b (Leontief) above θ* and at rate (1−η)(a+b) in Cobb-Douglas in the limit θ→1; both strictly exceed the pre-collapse rates. The apprenticeship externality gives a Pigouvian wedge non-decreasing on [0, θ*) for ρ ≤ 0 or ρ ∈ (0, 1/a) (under K_AI ≥ L_G), unbounded as θ→1 for ρ < 1/(a+b) in the smooth-threshold post-collapse regime, and collapsing to zero above θ* under hard promotion (g(ē) = 0). The wedge is distinct from a Lucas spillover because it grows endogenously in θ. Recursive verification shifts θ_inv leftward by ratio (K_AI − L_G)/(μK_AI − L_G), approaching 1/μ as K_AI → ∞, when AI output requires μ units of verification per unit of generation. A boundary proposition characterizes which professions collapse via the bundling share ζ_V of generation and verification within the productive act. Three adjustment margins (career extension, threshold reduction, endogenous AI verification) shift θ* rightward but cannot eliminate the collapse, since non-substitutability of the residual remains binding. Welfare aggregation shows that under near-Cobb-Douglas cross-profession aggregation (σ_a → 1) the least resilient profession sets the aggregate bottleneck; under gross complements (σ_a < 1) the collapsing profession dominates; in the intermediate regime (1 < σ_a < ∞) aggregate output remains positive after any single-profession collapse but the aggregate output decay rate is non-decreasing at each phase transition under Cobb-Douglas-within-profession with smooth promotion. Endogenous AI capacity yields a unique low-AI fixed point under monotonicity (Brouwer), with asymmetric hysteresis: the system can be pushed to the corner in finite time but recovery requires a full career length T = T_j + T_s. Quantitative calibration yields θ* ∈ {0.40, 0.20, 0.29} for software / radiology / law respectively, with collapse-onset ordering radiology → law → software, and lifetime Pigouvian per-junior subsidies in the range $1.55M–$3.21M under the Cobb-Douglas baseline (η = 0.5). The paper closes with five falsifiable predictions and three differentiated policy mechanisms. A companion Lean 4 / Mathlib machine-checked formalization is at https://github.com/crabsatellite/verification-asymmetry-lean4-formalization.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个隐性资本生产模型，研究AI如何逆转"生成昂贵、验证便宜"的传统经济不对称性，分析当AI使生成成本趋近于零而验证仍为隐性、劳动密集型时，学徒管道崩溃的相变现象及其政策含义。
AI.research_question: AI如何逆转传统隐性资本中生成与验证的成本不对称性？这种逆转对学徒管道、认证回报和社会福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 历史上生成成本高昂而验证成本低廉，隐性资本制度为此优化；AI将成本结构倒置——生成近乎免费，验证依然是隐性劳动密集型（Polanyi残差），这将对技能传递和职业制度产生深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐性资本生产模型（CES生成-验证产出）、AI替代率θ、经验积累函数h(τ)=τ^a、相变理论、Pigouvian楔子、Lucas溢出效应区分、递归验证、边界命题、福利加总、Brouwer不动点与滞后效应。
AI.method: 数理建模（CES生产函数、相变分析）、量化校准（软件/放射学/法律三个职业）、Lean 4/Mathlib机器验证形式化证明。
AI.findings: 不对称性反转是平滑均衡转型（θ_inv处切换约束因素）；学徒管道崩溃是相变（θ*处无新人群达晋升阈值，验证存量跳跃式下降且线性衰减至零）；认证回报衰减率在相变后严格增大；Pigouvian楔子在θ*处塌缩为零；递归验证左移θ_inv；量化校准得出各职业θ*值及补贴范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从隐性资本视角系统建模AI生成-验证不对称反转；提出学徒管道崩溃的相变理论；区分Pigouvian楔子与Lucas溢出效应（前者随θ内生增长）；揭示递归验证、职业捆绑份额、多重调整边际等机制；证明福利加总的瓶颈效应与滞后现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 给出三个职业（软件/放射学/法律）的崩溃阈值排序；提出终身Pigouvian补贴范围（155-321万美元）；提供五项可证伪预测和三项差异化政策机制；为AI对专业劳动力市场的影响提供定量政策依据。

title: Premium Tea as the Third Regime 4 Datapoint: A Single-category Replication of the v0.13 Covariate-saturated weak Finding

detail.title: Premium Tea as the Third Regime 4 Datapoint: A Single-category Replication of the v0.13 Covariate-saturated weak Finding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance, at Samsung Electronics America. This research is independent of Samsung, conducted outside the scope of employment, and represents the author's individual academic work under the Third System™ research entity. Samsung had no role in the design, acquisition, analysis, or interpretation of the research and is not a party to the deposit.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The research uses public APIs (LLM commercial endpoints; Google Trends) and synthetic prompts; no human subjects, no personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
Brand science distinguishes Mental Availability (memory salience) from Physical Availability (point-of-sale presence). The AIAS™ Measurement Programme introduces a third construct — AI Presence — operationalised as the rate at which each brand appears across matched LLM responses to category-recommendation prompts, and tests its construct validity against Google Trends rank as an external consumer-search proxy. v0.13 (five-category construct-validity expansion) identified a fourth empirical regime — Covariate-saturated weak (Regime 4) — in premium facial skincare and personal-finance apps. The regime was named provisionally pending a third independent replication.

v0.14 tests that replication in premium tea, a designed-for-test category selected for its highly fragmented brand landscape and the heavy weight of Asian-tradition specialty brands that English-language consumer search underrepresents. The pre-registered hypothesis H_Regime4_replication CONFIRMED at both measurement waves (t1 = 29 April 2026; t2 = 7 May 2026) and survives Tea Box-excluded sensitivity testing. All three pre-registered conditions hold at both waves: sample size n = 17 eligible brands worldwide (above the C1 floor of 12); bivariate Spearman rho(AI Presence × Google Trends) = -0.066 at t1 and -0.134 at t2 (within the C2 threshold |rho| < 0.35); partial rho after age + premium-tier control = -0.084 and -0.146 (satisfying C3 partial rho < 0). Tea Box-excluded sensitivity (n = 16) replicates: bivariate -0.011 / -0.129; partial -0.005 / -0.130.

Premium tea is the cleanest Regime 4 case observed in the programme to date. v0.13's skincare and finance both exhibited weakly positive bivariate rho that flipped to negative partial rho only after age and tier were controlled; premium tea bypasses that phase entirely, arriving at negative bivariate before any covariate adjustment. Three datapoints across three categories elevate Regime 4 from a provisional zone to a canonical pattern, and v0.14 evolves the headline classification axes from (bivariate rho × decrement) to (bivariate rho × partial rho) to accommodate categories with already-negative bivariate signal.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过v0.14版本的研究，在高端茶叶品类中成功复现了"协变量饱和弱相关（Regime 4）"这一经验模式，验证了AI Presence（大语言模型中的品牌出现率）与消费者搜索代理（Google Trends排名）之间的弱相关关系，从而将Regime 4从暂定状态提升为规范模式。
AI.research_question: 在高度碎片化的高端茶叶品牌市场中，AI Presence与消费者搜索代理（Google Trends排名）之间的关系是否呈现Regime 4模式（即协变量饱和弱相关），并能通过第三次独立复现验证？
AI.motivation: 在AIAS™测量项目的v0.13版本中，研究者发现了第四个经验模式——协变量饱和弱相关（Regime 4），但该模式仅为暂定命名，尚需第三次独立复现才能确认为规范模式。本文旨在通过精心设计的高端茶叶品类（品牌高度碎片化、传统亚洲品牌被英语消费者搜索低估）进行复现检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌科学中Mental Availability（记忆显著性）与Physical Availability（销售点可见性）的区分；AI Presence作为第三方构念；构念效度检验方法；协变量饱和弱相关的经验模式分类框架。
AI.method: 预注册假设检验；在两个测量波次（t1=2026年4月29日，t2=2026年5月7日）中收集数据；统计方法包括双变量斯皮尔曼相关分析和年龄+高端层级控制后的偏相关分析；进行Tea Box排除的敏感性检验。
AI.findings: 预注册假设H_Regime4_replication在两个测量波次均得到确认。三个条件均满足：样本量n=17（>C1下限12）；双变量rho分别为-0.066和-0.134（在|rho|<0.35阈值内）；控制后偏相关分别为-0.084和-0.146（满足C3偏相关<0条件）。Tea Box排除敏感性检验（n=16）也成功复现。高端茶叶是该项目迄今为止最干净的Regime 4案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过第三次独立复现，将Regime 4从暂定状态提升为规范模式；将分类轴从（双变量rho × 递减量）演进为（双变量rho × 偏相关），以容纳双变量信号已为负数的品类。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供了在高度碎片化、传统/文化取向品牌被主流搜索低估的市场中理解AI Presence与消费者搜索之间关系的实证依据；帮助品牌识别其在AI推荐环境中的实际可见性。

title: The Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™): A Socio-Technical Framework for AI-Mediated Visibility and Citation Authority

detail.title: The Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™): A Socio-Technical Framework for AI-Mediated Visibility and Citation Authority

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The development of the Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™) was conducted independently as part of the author’s academic and research activities.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual and does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. As such, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is fundamentally reshaping the digital discovery landscape. Traditional search engine optimization (SEO)predicated on document retrieval, ranking, and link-based authority-is increasingly insufficient as user behavior shifts toward AI-mediated "answer engines" that synthesize information from distributed knowledge sources. In this emerging paradigm, visibility is no longer determined by page position but by an organization's inclusion and attribution within AI-generated responses. This paper introduces the Knowledge Structuring Model (KSM™), a theoretical and managerial framework for guiding the strategic transition from SEO to answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO). Grounded in socio-technical systems theory and developed through a design science research (DSR) approach, KSM conceptualizes AI-mediated visibility as a function of three interdependent pillars: (1) extractable structured content, (2) entity salience and knowledge graph alignment, and (3) citation authority reinforcement. Drawing upon principles from semantic web technologies, information retrieval, and knowledge graph theory, the model advances a shift from document-centric optimization to entity-centric authority. The paper further proposes a governance model and measurement framework, addressing ethical considerations such as data accuracy and the privacy-visibility tradeoff. The study concludes with a structured roadmap and research agenda for organizations seeking to operationalize AI-native visibility in a post-search environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识结构化模型（KSM™），指导组织从传统SEO向答案引擎优化（AEO）和生成式引擎优化（GEO）的战略转型，以应对生成式AI重塑数字可见性的新范式。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI驱动的"答案引擎"时代，组织如何实现从传统搜索引擎优化向AI介导的可见性管理的战略转型？
AI.motivation: 用户行为从"检索文档"转向"获取AI合成答案"，传统基于文档检索、排序和链接权威的SEO范式已失效，组织亟需新的理论框架来指导AI时代的数字可见性策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论、语义网技术、信息检索理论、知识图谱理论
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法（Design Science Research, DSR）
AI.findings: AI介导的可见性取决于三个相互依赖的支柱：（1）可提取的结构化内容；（2）实体显著性与知识图谱对齐；（3）引文权威强化。推动从"以文档为中心"到"以实体为中心"的优化范式转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建从SEO到AEO/GEO转型的理论框架（KSM），提出"实体中心权威"这一新概念，整合社会技术系统理论与知识图谱理论解释AI介导的可见性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的KSM框架、治理模型、测量框架以及结构化路线图，帮助组织在"后搜索环境"中制定AI原生可见性战略。

title: The Reset Premium: Option Value under Asymmetric Price Commitment
affiliations: University of Central Florida - College of Business Administration - Department of Economics and IMD

detail.title: The Reset Premium: Option Value under Asymmetric Price Commitment
detail.abstract: We show that a one-sided price-adjustment rule, with free price cuts but a fixed daily resetfor price increases, raises the reset price even under risk neutrality, mean-zero wholesalecost shocks, and perfect consumer information. The mechanism is option-theoretic:a higher reset price preserves pass-through in adverse cost states, while favorable shockscan still be accommodated by price cuts. In differentiated Bertrand competition, thereset premium scales with cost pass-through and hence with substitutability. The mechanismis distinct from consumer search and strategic price dispersion because it operateseven under perfect consumer price information.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，即使是在风险中性、批发成本冲击均值为零且消费者信息完全的情况下，单边价格调整规则（允许自由降价但涨价需固定每日重置）也会提高重置价格。其机制是期权式的：较高的重置价格可以在不利成本状态下保持传导，而有利冲击则可通过降价来吸收。在差异化伯川德竞争中，重置溢价随成本传导程度（进而随产品替代性）而递增。该机制不同于消费者搜索和策略性价格离散，因为它即使在消费者完全知晓价格的情况下也成立。
AI.research_question: 单边价格调整规则（允许自由降价但涨价需固定每日重置）是否会提高重置价格？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解价格调整规则（如"每日平价"承诺）对均衡价格水平的影响，揭示即使在没有消费者搜索摩擦、信息不对称或风险规避等传统因素下，单边价格调整规则本身如何导致价格上升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权理论（option theory）：将重置价格视为一种期权，高重置价格允许企业在成本不利时传导成本（通过不降价），而在成本有利时则可通过降价来吸收。同时结合差异化伯川德竞争模型分析竞争效应。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，在风险中性、均值为零的批发成本冲击、消费者完全信息等假设下，推导单边价格调整规则对重置价格的影响，并引入差异化伯川德竞争分析产品替代性的作用。
AI.findings: (1) 单边价格调整规则会提高重置价格，即使是在风险中性、零均值成本冲击和完全消费者信息下；(2) 机制是期权式的：高重置价格允许在不利成本状态传导成本，有利状态通过降价吸收；(3) 在差异化伯川德竞争中，重置溢价随成本传导程度和产品替代性递增；(4) 该机制与消费者搜索或策略性价格离散无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的、基于期权理论的机制来解释价格调整规则如何影响价格水平，区别于传统的消费者搜索、信息摩擦和风险规避等解释，丰富了定价理论和价格刚性的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对零售商制定价格承诺策略（如"每日平价"）有重要启示：这类看似对消费者友好的规则实际上可能导致更高的均衡价格；对反垄断和消费者保护政策也有参考意义。

reference: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 235
title: Unpacking Social Exposure
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance and Management, University of Zurich - Department of Finance, Frankfurt  School of Finance and Management and The University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Unpacking Social Exposure

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 235
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a method to measure firms' exposures to social issues from earningscall transcripts. The method applies large language models and decomposes social exposure into five domains: Employee Welfare, DEI, Stakeholder Outreach, Ethical Commitments, and Crisis Response. The measures cover over 15,000 firms across 93 countries from 2003 to 2024. The five domains exhibit distinct, sometimes opposing, associations with labor outcomes, productivity, and ESG ratings. Aggregating domains of differing sign attenuates estimated effects, consistent with the weak findings reported for composite social scores. Domains correlate with labor-market outcomes and productivity in different directions; the aggregate averages these correlations toward zero. Exploiting the Dobbs decision, which tightened abortion regulation, as a labor-supply shock, we find that firms with higher pre-Dobbs DEI exposure experienced a lower worker outflow than non-exposed firms in the same state and month.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型从财报电话会议记录中提取企业社会暴露度，将其分解为五个维度（员工福利、DEI、利益相关者 outreach、道德承诺、危机应对），覆盖93个国家15000多家企业（2003-2024），发现各维度与劳动力结果、生产率和ESG评级呈不同甚至相反的关系，聚合后效应相互抵消。以Dobbs判决作为劳动供给冲击，发现DEI暴露度高的企业工人流出更少。
AI.research_question: 如何从财报电话会议中有效测量企业对社会议题的暴露度，以及不同维度的社会暴露如何影响企业劳动力结果、生产率和ESG评级？
AI.motivation: 现有综合社会评分（如ESG中的"S"）往往发现弱且不一致的结果，可能是因为聚合了方向不同的子维度。需要更细粒度的测量方法来揭示社会暴露的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、利益相关者理论、企业社会暴露的多维度分解框架。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLMs）从财报电话会议记录中提取文本特征，将社会暴露分解为五个维度。样本覆盖2003-2024年93个国家15000+家企业。利用Dobbs判决作为准自然实验进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 五个社会暴露维度与劳动力结果、生产率呈不同甚至相反的方向；聚合综合指标会使效应相互抵消趋近于零；Dobbs判决后，高DEI暴露的企业面临更低的工人流出率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示社会暴露的多维异质性，解释为什么综合社会评分通常发现弱效应；提出更精细的测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供更精确的社会议题暴露测量工具；为投资者和政策制定者理解ESG评级中的"S"维度提供新视角；为企业在社会事件（如堕胎政策变化）中的劳动力管理提供参考。

title: The Radial Disruption Field: A Predictive Framework for Industrial Blast Radius Mapping

detail.title: The Radial Disruption Field: A Predictive Framework for Industrial Blast Radius Mapping
detail.abstract:
Most executives recognize a technology disruption after it has already hit their industry. By then, the displacement timeline is running and the window to respond is shrinking. This paper presents a framework for predicting which industries will be
displaced by a new technology, how severely, and when — before any displacement has occurred.

The Radial Disruption Field uses a single measurable property of each new technology — how much of its sub-technology stack it shares with adjacent industries — to calculate blast radius, field strength, and displacement timelines. Validated against seven disruptions spanning 1838 to 2022, the framework predicts industry displacement timing with a mean error under 1.5 years. A supplementary employment onset validation against BLS QCEW data for three completed disruptions produced an onset-based MAE of 0.00 years.

Three findings carry direct strategic weight. Industries showing revenue growth while losing market share have already entered the blast radius — revenue is a lagging indicator of disruption, not a leading one. A single disruption can arrive in
multiple waves years apart, each triggered by a specific capability threshold, meaning executives who survive the first wave face subsequent ones they may not have anticipated. And browser-native technologies deploy 40-60% faster than
older disruptions regardless of how mature their underlying components are, compressing the response window for AI-driven disruption to the shortest in the industrial record.

Applied prospectively to AI coding tools and Google Search, the framework produces specific displacement timelines by role and query type — and identifies a structural engineering talent gap that will peak in the mid-2030s as a second-order
consequence of current junior hiring collapse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“径向破坏场”（Radial Disruption Field）框架，通过衡量新技术与相邻行业共享子技术栈的比例，在破坏发生前预测哪些行业将被颠覆、颠覆程度及时间线。经1838-2022年七次颠覆验证，预测误差均值小于1.5年；并前瞻性应用于AI编程工具和谷歌搜索，给出具体的颠覆时间线及人才缺口预测。
AI.research_question: 如何在行业颠覆发生之前，预测哪些行业会被新技术颠覆、颠覆的严重程度以及何时发生？
AI.motivation: 大多数高管只能在技术颠覆冲击本行业后才意识到其发生，此时应对窗口已迅速缩小。现有方法缺乏在颠覆发生前进行系统性预测的工具，管理者亟需一个前瞻性框架以便提前布局。
AI.theoretical_framework: “径向破坏场”（Radial Disruption Field）框架。核心变量是新技术与其相邻行业共享子技术栈的比例（sub-technology stack overlap），基于此计算三个关键指标：爆炸半径（blast radius）、场强（field strength）和颠覆时间线（displacement timelines）。
AI.method: 1. 提出RDF框架及可测指标；2. 对1838年至2022年间的七次历史技术颠覆进行回顾性验证；3. 使用BLS QCEW就业数据进行补充验证；4. 前瞻性应用于AI编程工具和谷歌搜索两个案例。
AI.findings: 1. 框架预测行业颠覆时间点的平均误差小于1.5年，就业验证MAE为0.00年；2. 收入增长但市场份额下降的行业已进入爆炸半径，收入是滞后指标；3. 同一颠覆可能以多波次形式抵达，每波由特定能力阈值触发；4. 浏览器原生技术部署速度比旧颠覆快40-60%，AI驱动的颠覆应对窗口为工业史上最短；5. 应用于AI编程工具和谷歌搜索可给出按角色和查询类型划分的具体颠覆时间线；6. 识别出2030年代中期将出现结构性工程人才缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个能够在颠覆发生前进行定量预测的框架，将技术颠覆研究从事后归因转向事前预测。引入“子技术栈共享度”这一可测变量作为预测核心，丰富了技术变革与产业颠覆的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一个可操作的前瞻性工具，用于识别早期预警信号（如收入增长但份额下降）、预判多波次颠覆节奏、评估AI时代极短的应对窗口期，并指导人才战略（如应对2030年代中期的工程人才缺口）。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Realm of Copyright Law: An Analytical Study
affiliations: Maharashtra National Law University , Nagpur

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Realm of Copyright Law: An Analytical Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA

detail.abstract: In the contemporary digital era, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a significant contributor to the creation of diverse creative works, ranging from literature and films to music and software. This paper delves into the intricate interplay between AI and Copyright Law, with a special emphasis on the Indian legal landscape. The study is rooted in the observation that the Indian copyright system, in its current form, struggles to accommodate the surge in AI-generated works. This predicament has given rise to widespread ambiguity regarding the copyright protection applicable to such works, not only within India but also on an international scale. The paper seeks to unravel this complexity by questioning the capacity of AI-generated works to fulfil the fundamental prerequisites of creative works as stipulated by copyright legislation. It further explores the intricate dynamics of authorship and ownership in the AI context, posing critical questions: can the AI or its programmer be deemed the author? Is it feasible to consider AI as a co-author or even accord it the status of legal personhood? Aiming to shed light on these issues, the research proposes potential solutions, drawing upon international norms and practices adopted by developed nations such as the European Union, the United States of America and Japan. In conclusion, this paper aspires to enrich the discourse on AI and copyright law, offering valuable insights that could guide lawmakers, practitioners, and scholars in navigating this complex intersection.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能生成作品在印度版权法体系下面临的挑战，分析了AI作品能否满足版权保护的基本要件，以及AI、程序员或用户之间的作者身份与所有权归属问题，并借鉴欧盟、美国、日本等国际经验提出解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在印度版权法框架下，AI生成的作品能否获得版权保护？AI、其程序员或用户谁应被视为作者或版权所有人？是否可能赋予AI法律人格或共同作者地位？
AI.motivation: 印度现行版权体系难以适应AI生成作品的爆发式增长，导致国内及国际范围内关于此类作品版权保护的普遍模糊与不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权法基本理论（作品独创性要件、作者身份认定、所有权归属）、法律人格理论、国际版权协调框架（欧盟、美国、日本的相关立法与实践）。
AI.method: 比较法研究——通过分析欧盟、美国、日本等发达国家的法律规范与国际实践，结合印度现行版权法进行对比与借鉴。
AI.findings: AI生成作品在满足版权法独创性要件方面存在困难；作者身份归属存在争议（AI、程序员、用户三者间的权责模糊）；印度现行法缺乏对AI生成作品的明确保护条款；国际层面尚无统一做法，但发达国家已开始探索针对性立法或判例规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了AI生成作品与版权法核心概念（独创性、作者身份、法律人格）之间的理论张力，为版权法在人工智能时代的概念拓展提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度立法者、司法实践者和版权从业人员提供了可操作的制度建议，包括借鉴国际经验完善国内法律框架，明确AI生成作品的版权归属规则，减少法律不确定性。

title: Legal Deserts Over Time
affiliations: University of Kentucky - J. David Rosenberg College of Law

detail.title: Legal Deserts Over Time
detail.abstract:
Legal deserts—counties with exceptionally low attorney availability—shape housing stability, personal safety, health outcomes, and economic security in rural communities.  Yet, national scholarship has not yet determined whether attorney scarcity is transient or durable and relies largely on cross-sectional snapshots and population-based headcounts benchmarked to the American Bar Association’s (ABA) threshold of one attorney per 1,000 residents.  These measures can obscure temporal dynamics, overstate functional supply, and embed contested normative assumptions about adequacy.

This Article offers a national, longitudinal, and definition-sensitive analysis of legal deserts using county-level data from the forty-eight contiguous states at three observation points.  Attorney supply is measured using employment-based data from the U.S. Census Bureau’s County Business Patterns and assessed using both the ABA benchmark and an emerging, demand-adjusted threshold of 0.5 attorneys per 1,000 residents, alongside attorney gap measures calibrated to the rural-urban context. The analysis further situates attorney scarcity within place-based structural conditions by examining variation across rurality, Appalachian Regional Commission counties, and persistent poverty counties.

Across both definitions, legal deserts are overwhelmingly persistent.  Counties rarely exited desert status over the eight-year observation period, and entry more often reflected sustained erosion.  How a legal desert is defined materially alters the picture of scarcity: the ABA definition identifies a larger, more margin-sensitive set of counties with greater apparent movement, while the demand-adjusted threshold isolates a smaller but more entrenched set facing severe shortages.  Legal deserts cluster in geographically isolated counties and are disproportionately concentrated in Appalachian and persistent poverty counties, where long-term economic distress compounds rural disadvantage.  Proximity to metropolitan areas often substitutes for, rather than rebuilds, locally embedded legal capacity.  Together, these findings recast legal deserts as a durable infrastructure deficit and suggest that access-to-justice policy should be evaluated by whether it restores stable local capacity over time.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国本土48个县的面板数据，通过两种定义阈值（ABA标准1名律师/千人；需求调整阈值0.5名律师/千人）对"法律荒漠"进行纵向分析，发现律师稀缺具有高度持续性，且需求调整阈值识别出规模更小但更根深蒂固的短缺县。法律荒漠集中在地理孤立县、阿巴拉契亚区域委员会县和持续贫困县，靠近都市区往往替代而非重建本地法律能力，研究将法律荒漠重新定义为一种持久的基础设施赤字。
AI.research_question: 美国农村地区的律师稀缺是短暂现象还是持久性结构问题？不同定义阈值如何影响对法律荒漠的识别？法律荒漠在空间上如何分布？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要依赖横截面快照和人口基数法（ABA阈值），无法捕捉时间动态，可能高估功能供给，且嵌入了有争议的规范假设。需要更精确的纵向研究来理解法律荒漠的持续性及其政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律荒漠理论（Legal Deserts）；基础设施赤字视角（Infrastructure Deficit）；律师供给的阈值定义方法（ABA基准 vs. 需求调整阈值）；空间依赖与替代效应（都市区替代 vs. 本地重建）
AI.method: 使用美国人口调查局县商业模式数据库的就业数据，对48个州在三个观察时间点进行面板分析；采用两种阈值（ABA的1名律师/千人；需求调整的0.5名律师/千人）；结合律师缺口指标进行城乡情境校准；按农村性、阿巴拉契亚区域委员会县、持续贫困县进行分组变异分析。
AI.findings: 1）两种定义下，法律荒漠均高度持续，县在8年观察期内很少脱离荒漠状态；2）ABA定义识别出更大、更边缘、表面变动更多的县；需求调整阈值识别出更小但更根深蒂固的严重短缺县；3）法律荒漠集中在地理孤立县、阿巴拉契亚县和持续贫困县；4）靠近都市区往往替代而非重建本地法律能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律荒漠重新概念化为一种持久的基础设施赤字，而非短暂的市场波动；揭示了不同定义阈值对识别法律荒漠严重性和持续性的系统影响；建立了律师稀缺与地方结构性条件（贫困、地理隔离）之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法可及性政策提供评估标准：政策应以其是否能够恢复长期稳定的本地法律能力来评判；为政策制定者提供了更精准的识别工具（需求调整阈值），避免ABA标准可能导致的误判；明确了政策干预应优先瞄准持续贫困县和阿巴拉契亚县等结构性弱势地区。

title: Key contractual factors influencing safety practices on construction sites
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Key contractual factors influencing safety practices on construction sites
detail.abstract: Occupational safety and health (OSH) problems remain prevalent in the construction industry. Previous research has emphasized on-site hazards, fragmented project organization, and client engagement, but less is known about how contractual arrangements shape safety practices during the construction phase. This paper examines which contractual factors enable good safety practices in construction projects.,The empirical foundation for the study is 17 construction projects, combining assessments of tender and contract documents with ethnographic fieldwork on active construction sites. Contractual conditions and observed safety practices were analyzed using Coincidence Analysis and interpreted through qualitative case vignettes.,The analysis identifies three pathways to strong safety round practices, which in turn co-occurred with higher scores on safety practice on site. 1) high-quality contract material combined with explicit descriptions of OSH methods reduced ambiguity and supported routine preventive work. 2) explicit OSH methods were effective when connected to a hierarchy-of-controls logic that directed attention toward elimination, substitution, and higher-order risk controls. 3) systematic OSH management descriptions, including clear roles, meeting structures, feedback loops, and coordinator mandates, could independently support effective safety rounds. Case vignettes illustrate how these contractual configurations were enacted in practice, and how weak contract descriptions were associated with more ad hoc safety work.,The study shows how contracts and plans for health and safety (PHS) can function as upstream organizational devices shaping practical safety coordination. The findings suggest that clients and OSH professionals can strengthen construction-phase safety by specifying OSH methods, applying hierarchy-of-controls thinking, and embedding safety rounds within systematic management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过17个建筑项目的实证分析，发现了三种通过合同安排促进施工现场安全实践的路径，揭示了合同条款如何作为上游组织工具影响实际安全协调。
AI.research_question: 哪些合同因素能够促进建筑项目施工阶段的安全实践？
AI.motivation: 建筑业职业安全与健康问题普遍存在，以往研究侧重现场 hazards、碎片化项目组织和客户参与，但对合同安排如何塑造施工阶段安全实践了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同设计与安全实践的关联机制；层级控制逻辑（Hierarchy of Controls）；系统性安全管理框架。
AI.method: 对17个建筑项目进行实证研究，结合招标与合同文件评估与施工现场民族志田野调查，使用一致性分析（Coincidence Analysis）进行量化分析，并通过定性案例小插图进行解释。
AI.findings: 识别出三条通往良好安全巡检实践的路径：1）高质量合同材料与明确的职业安全与健康方法描述相结合；2）明确的职业安全与健康方法关联层级控制逻辑；3）系统性的职业安全与健康管理描述可独立支持有效的安全巡检。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了合同与安全计划可作为上游组织工具塑造实际安全协调，拓展了建筑安全管理领域对合同安排作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议客户和职业安全与健康专业人员通过明确职业安全与健康方法、应用层级控制逻辑、将安全巡检嵌入系统化管理来加强施工阶段安全。

title: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and Corporate Green Innovation: Evidence from the Hong Kong Exchange's 2020 Policy Upgrade
affiliations: Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation (CAITEC)

detail.title: Mandatory ESG Disclosure and Corporate Green Innovation: Evidence from the Hong Kong Exchange's 2020 Policy Upgrade
detail.abstract: We examine whether mandatory ESG disclosure is associated with changes in corporate green innovation, using the Hong Kong Exchange's 2020 policy upgrade as a quasi-natural experiment. In a matched panel of 153 Chinese firms (2012-2023) with A+H cross-listed firms as the treatment group, green patent grants show a positive estimate at lag 2 (adjusted p = 0.042 after core-family Bonferroni correction). Application-side estimates are positive at lag 1 (adjusted p = 0.068), directional but above the 5% threshold. The distributed lag model confirms application effects concentrate at lag 1 and grant effects at lag 2, consistent with patent examination cycles. The response is concentrated in invention patents without quality-proxy improvement. Standard transmission channels produce null results. Under full-family Bonferroni correction (21 tests), no result passes 5%. These findings point to a directional quantity response without quality improvement, extending the quantity-quality divergence literature to mandatory disclosure.

AI.tldr: 利用港交所2020年强制ESG披露政策升级作为准自然实验，研究发现强制ESG披露促使企业绿色专利数量增加（申请滞后1年、授权滞后2年），但质量未提升；在多重假设检验校正后结果不稳健，说明存在方向性数量反应但无质量改善。
AI.research_question: 强制ESG披露是否与企业绿色创新变化相关？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对ESG披露与绿色创新的关系存在争议，且缺乏利用准自然实验识别因果效应的中国情境研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合法性理论、信号理论与代理理论，探讨强制ESG披露如何影响企业绿色创新的数量与质量。
AI.method: 采用双重差分（DID）和分布式滞后模型，以A+H交叉上市公司为处理组、匹配面板数据（2012-2023年共153家中国企业），并进行多重假设检验校正（Bonferroni校正）。
AI.findings: (1) 绿色专利授权在滞后2年正向显著（校正p=0.042）；(2) 绿色专利申请在滞后1年正向但不显著（校正p=0.068）；(3) 反应集中于发明专利，但质量代理指标无改善；(4) 传统传导渠道检验无显著结果；(5) 全族Bonferroni校正（21项检验）后无结果通过5%显著性水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"数量-质量分化"文献拓展至强制ESG披露领域，揭示了制度压力下企业创新行为的策略性调整机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估强制ESG披露的实际效果提供证据，提示需关注创新质量而不仅是数量；为企业应对ESG监管压力下的创新策略提供参考。

title: Fiscal Dominance by Coordination: Burden-sharing and the Attenuation of Monetary Policy Space in Indonesia
affiliations: Universitas Halu Oleo and Universitas Halu Oleo

detail.title: Fiscal Dominance by Coordination: Burden-sharing and the Attenuation of Monetary Policy Space in Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or non-financial interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently and without any commercial or political interference. No external funding was received for this study. The views and interpretations presented in this paper are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the official position of any institution affiliated with the authors.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required under the institutional and national research guidelines applicable to this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper documents empirical patterns consistent with fiscal dominance by coordination in Indonesia's 2020-2024 burden-sharing episode. Using a smoothingaugmented Taylor rule estimated via GMM-IV, we find that Bank Indonesia's long-run inflation responsiveness declines from 0.955 under low fiscal stress to 0.420 under high stress. Crosscountry placebo tests across six EMEs show that comparable economies did not experience similar reaction-function attenuation, confirming Indonesia-specificity. Event studies and state-dependent local projections provide corroborating evidence of amplified bond-yield sensitivity under elevated fiscal stress. The findings suggest that quasi-fiscal coordination without institutional safeguards can attenuate monetary policy space in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印尼2020-2024年"负担分担"时期的经验数据，实证发现财政主导通过协调机制削弱了货币政策的独立性。通过GMM-IV估计的平滑泰勒规则显示，印尼央行长期通胀反应系数从低财政压力时的0.955降至高压力时的0.420，且这一现象在跨国安慰剂检验中具有印尼特异性。事件研究和状态依赖局部投影法进一步证实了债券收益率对财政压力的敏感性放大。
AI.research_question: 印尼2020-2024年"负担分担"过程中，财政-货币政策协调是否导致了财政主导，进而削弱了货币政策的独立性？
AI.motivation: 在新冠疫情后，许多新兴市场国家采取了财政-货币协调政策（如印尼的负担分担机制），但这种准财政协调可能以牺牲央行独立性为代价。理解这种协调是否以及如何导致财政主导，对于设计制度保障至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政主导理论（fiscal dominance theory）、泰勒规则（Taylor rule）、货币政策独立性、准财政协调（quasi-fiscal coordination）
AI.method: 采用平滑增强型泰勒规则（smoothing-augmented Taylor rule），使用GMM-IV方法估计；进行跨国安慰剂检验（跨6个新兴市场国家）；采用事件研究和状态依赖局部投影法（state-dependent local projections）进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）印尼央行长期通胀反应系数在低财政压力时为0.955，高压力时降至0.420；（2）跨国安慰剂检验显示其他新兴市场国家未出现类似反应函数减弱；（3）事件研究和局部投影法证实高财政压力下债券收益率敏感性放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 为财政主导理论提供了微观机制层面的新证据——通过财政-货币协调通道实现财政主导；量化了准财政协调对货币政策独立性的侵蚀程度；拓展了新兴市场背景下泰勒规则衰减的条件因素研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示新兴市场国家在采用财政-货币协调机制时需建立制度保障；为央行独立性评估提供了新的经验检测方法（通过反应函数衰减检验）；为国际货币基金组织等机构对新兴市场国家政策评估提供了参考依据。

title: Token Budgets as Incentive Instruments
affiliations: Chongqing University - School of Economics and Business Admininstration

detail.title: Token Budgets as Incentive Instruments
detail.abstract: We study when and how generously firms should subsidize AI access through token budgets. A firm hires a worker who allocates AI use between productive experimentation and private "gaming." A larger budget lowers the worker's marginal cost of AI use, making experimentation cheaper to induce, but shifts token spending to the firm and potentially subsidizes gaming. Absent gaming, uncapped access is optimal: the firm fully finances AI use to minimize incentive payments. When gaming is possible, finite or zero budgets can be optimal as disciplinary devices; yet uncapped access remains optimal if high experimentation crowds out gaming. In competitive labor markets, token budgets can support first-best equilibria that a zero budget cannot. Stronger competition can tighten access limits, while higher token prices may relax them. Token budgets are therefore best understood not merely as tools for talent attraction or cost control, but as incentive instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了企业应如何通过token预算补贴员工AI使用。当员工可将AI用于生产性实验或私人“游戏”时，最优token预算取决于实验对游戏的挤出效应、劳动力市场竞争程度和token价格。在无游戏行为时，无上限访问最优；存在游戏时，有限或零预算可作为惩戒工具，但若实验能挤出游戏，无上限访问仍可能最优。竞争加剧可能收紧访问限制，而token价格上涨可能放宽限制。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何通过token预算（补贴）来最优地管理员工对AI的访问权限，以平衡激励生产性实验和抑制私人游戏行为？
AI.motivation: AI时代企业普遍面临如何向员工分配AI访问权限的问题。token预算作为新型激励工具，其最优设计不仅关乎成本控制，更涉及激励设计，现有文献对此缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论、激励理论、多任务道德风险模型（生产性实验vs.私人游戏）
AI.method: 理论模型分析（合约理论/机制设计）
AI.findings: 1）无游戏风险时，无上限访问最优；2）存在游戏时，有限或零预算可作为惩戒工具；3）若高实验水平能挤出游戏行为，无上限访问仍可能最优；4）竞争性劳动力市场中，token预算可支持零预算无法实现的一阶最优均衡；5）更强竞争收紧访问限制，更高token价格可能放宽限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将token预算重新概念化为激励工具而非单纯的补贴或控制手段，拓展了委托代理理论在AI治理场景的应用，揭示了竞争环境对最优合约设计的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计AI访问策略提供理论指导：管理者应综合考虑员工游戏倾向、实验价值、市场竞争程度和token成本，而非简单追求成本最小化或人才吸引。

title: A Fuzzy Metric Approach to Composite Health Indicators
affiliations: University of Granada, Polytechnic University of Valencia, Polytechnic University of Valencia and University of Granada

detail.title: A Fuzzy Metric Approach to Composite Health Indicators

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently and solely according to academic and scientific criteria.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is purely theoretical and does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted without financial support from any public, commercial, or non-profit funding agency.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve a clinical trial or any human or medical intervention requiring trial registration.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper is under review at Fuzzy Sets and Systems.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a fuzzy metric-based framework for the construction of composite indicators that avoids normalization and exogenous weighting schemes. Instead of transforming the data, the methodology evaluates observations through their proximity to a reference profile within a fuzzy metric space, preserving the intrinsic geometry of the original variables. The approach introduces an endogenous sensitivity mechanism that adjusts the contribution of each dimension according to its effective discriminatory power, providing a structure-consistent alternative to traditional weighting methods. From a theoretical perspective, the framework is formulated in terms of factorizable fuzzy metrics and aggregation functions that preserve the underlying metric structure. In particular, a multiplicative aggregation scheme is shown to yield a coherent representation consistent with distance-based composite indicators, establishing a formal link with the Pena Trapero distance through an exponential transformation. An empirical application to health system performance illustrates the proposed methodology. The results indicate that the fuzzy metric approach produces stable rankings under sample perturbations and reduces the impact of redundant information. Sensitivity analysis further shows that the resulting rankings are less affected by variations in weights, supporting the robustness and structural coherence of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊度量的复合指标构建框架，无需数据标准化和外生赋权，通过观测值与参考轮廓在模糊度量空间中的接近度来评估，并引入内生敏感性机制调整各维度贡献，实证表明该方法产生稳定排序、减少冗余信息影响且对权重变动不敏感。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种无需数据标准化和外生赋权、能保留原始变量内在几何结构的复合指标方法？
AI.motivation: 传统复合指标构建方法依赖数据标准化和外生权重设定，可能扭曲数据原始结构且权重设定主观性强，需要一种结构一致的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊度量理论（可分解模糊度量）、聚合函数（保度量结构的乘性聚合）、Pena Trapero距离（通过指数变换建立形式联系）。
AI.method: 基于模糊度量空间的近接性评估方法，引入内生的敏感性机制（根据各维度的有效区分力动态调整贡献），采用乘性聚合方案构建复合指标。
AI.findings: （1）模糊度量方法在样本扰动下产生稳定排序；（2）减少冗余信息的影响；（3）排序结果对权重变动不敏感，具有稳健性和结构一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了可分解模糊度量与保度量聚合函数的理论框架；（2）通过指数变换建立了乘性聚合方案与Pena Trapero距离之间的形式联系，为距离类复合指标提供了新理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）避免了标准化和外生赋权带来的主观性问题；（2）内生敏感性机制使指标构建更贴合数据自身结构；（3）以卫生系统绩效为例验证了方法的可行性与稳健性，为政策评估等领域提供了更可靠的复合指标工具。

title: Why Small Economies Converge to Fiscal Dumping: Scale Asymmetry, Institutional Feedback, and Regime Persistence
affiliations: University College Dublin (UCD)

detail.title: Why Small Economies Converge to Fiscal Dumping: Scale Asymmetry, Institutional Feedback, and Regime Persistence
detail.abstract: A small number of jurisdictions persistently attract a disproportionate share of global multinational profits through fiscal dumping-the systematic undercutting of international tax benchmarks. Existing models of tax competition characterize the strategic interactions sustaining such regimes, but say little about the structural conditions that make them feasible. This paper develops a minimal structural framework in which fiscal dumping emerges endogenously from two forces: the exposure of a jurisdiction to mobile profits relative to its domestic scale, and the institutional feedback generated by established multinational activity. A sharp activation threshold separates jurisdictions for which fiscal deviation is structurally sustainable from those for which it is not. Beyond this threshold, institutional feedback may generate multiple equilibria and path dependence. An illustrative mapping of jurisdictions into the (Θ, α) spacewithout relying on statutory tax rates-shows that economies associated with fiscal dumping tend to cluster in regions where the framework predicts persistent deviation to be sustainable. The results suggest that fiscal dumping reflects structural asymmetries in scale, mobility, and institutional capacity, with direct implications for the design of coordination mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个最小化结构框架，揭示财政倾销（通过系统性地压低国际税收基准来吸引全球跨国利润）的内生性条件。研究发现，一个司法管辖区的结构性特征——暴露于流动利润的程度（相对于其国内规模）以及由既有跨国活动产生的制度反馈——共同决定了财政偏离是否可持续，且存在一个尖锐的激活阈值。超过该阈值，制度反馈可能导致多重均衡和路径依赖。将各司法管辖区映射到(Θ, α)空间的结果表明，与财政倾销相关的经济体倾向于集中在框架预测可持续偏离的区域。
AI.research_question: 哪些结构性条件使得某些司法管辖区能够通过财政倾销（系统性压低国际税收基准）持续吸引全球跨国利润？
AI.motivation: 现有税收竞争模型刻画了维持此类制度的战略互动，但对使其可行的结构性条件鲜有说明。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) 暴露度（jurisdiction对流动利润的暴露程度 vs. 国内规模）；(2) 制度反馈（既有跨国活动产生的路径依赖和多重均衡）。一个尖锐的激活阈值区分了财政偏离在结构上可持续与不可持续的司法管辖区。
AI.method: 构建最小化结构框架（Minimal Structural Framework），将各司法管辖区映射到(Θ, α)空间进行理论分析，未依赖法定税率进行识别。
AI.findings: (1) 财政倾销从暴露度与制度反馈两种力量中内生涌现；(2) 存在一个尖锐的激活阈值；(3) 超过阈值后可能出现多重均衡和路径依赖；(4) 与财政倾销相关的经济体在(Θ, α)空间中聚类于框架预测可持续偏离的区域。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收竞争研究从战略互动层面推进到结构性条件层面，揭示了财政倾销的结构性根源（规模不对称、流动性不对称和制度能力不对称），并引入多重均衡和路径依赖的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计国际税收协调机制提供了结构性诊断工具，帮助识别哪些司法管辖区更可能成为财政倾销的源头，从而更有针对性地制定政策应对措施。

title: Financial Conditions and Growth-at-Risk in Jordan: A PCA-based Composite Index Approach
affiliations: Arab Monetary Fund

detail.title: Financial Conditions and Growth-at-Risk in Jordan: A PCA-based Composite Index Approach
detail.abstract:
This study constructs a comprehensive Financial Conditions Index (FCI) for Jordan using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and examines its implications for downside risks to future economic growth within a nonlinear Growth-at-Risk (GaR) framework over the quarterly period 2005Q1-2024Q4. The analysis integrates macro-financial factor extraction, quantile regression techniques, and regimedependent estimation to assess how financial conditions influence both the average and lower tail of the future GDP growth distribution in a small open emerging economy. 

The PCA-based FCI is constructed using a broad set of domestic and external financial indicators, including interest rates, credit growth, money supply, stock market returns, sovereign spreads, foreign reserves, inflation, and exchange-rate volatility. The estimated index appears to co-move with major episodes of macro-financial stress in Jordan, including the Global Financial Crisis, regional geopolitical instability, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the recent global monetary tightening cycle. 

The GaR estimation results reveal that tighter financial conditions significantly increase downside risks to future economic growth, particularly at the lower quantiles of the GDP growth distribution. Quantile regression estimates show that a one-standard-deviation tightening in financial conditions reduces the 5 th percentile of future GDP growth by approximately 1.4 percentage points, while the impact on median growth outcomes remains comparatively moderate. The nonlinear threshold analysis further demonstrates that the adverse effects of financial tightening intensify substantially once financial stress exceeds a critical threshold level, confirming the presence of asymmetric macro-financial amplification mechanisms. 

The results highlight the potential relevance of financial conditions as a forward-looking indicator of macroeconomic risk and support their use in macroprudential monitoring frameworks in emerging economies. More broadly, the study contributes to the growing literature on financial conditions and tailrisk dynamics in emerging economies by providing new empirical evidence on nonlinear macro-financial transmission mechanisms in a small open economy.

AI.tldr: 本文为约旦构建了基于主成分分析的金融状况指数(FCI)，并利用非线性增长风险(GaR)框架，发现金融条件收紧显著增加了未来GDP增长的下行风险，且存在非线性放大机制。
AI.research_question: 金融状况如何影响新兴小型开放经济体未来经济增长的下行尾部风险？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体面临频繁的金融压力事件（全球金融危机、地缘政治动荡、疫情、全球货币紧缩），需要构建综合金融状况指数并评估其对经济增长尾部风险的非线性影响，为宏观审慎监测提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长风险(Growth-at-Risk, GaR)框架、量化回归、非线性阈值分析、宏观金融放大机制理论。
AI.method: 主成分分析法(PCA)构建FCI；分位数回归估计不同分位点下金融条件对GDP增长的影响；非线性阈值分析识别金融压力的临界阈值及不对称放大效应。数据为约旦2005Q1-2024Q4的季度数据。
AI.findings: (1) PCA构建的FCI与约旦主要金融压力事件高度吻合；(2) 金融条件收紧显著增加GDP增长的下行尾部风险：一个标准差收紧使第5百分位GDP增长下降约1.4个百分点，对中位数影响较小；(3) 金融压力超过临界阈值后，紧缩效应显著放大，存在非对称的宏观金融放大机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴经济体金融条件与尾部风险动态的文献提供了新的实证证据，揭示小型开放经济体中非线性宏观金融传导机制的存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 验证了FCI作为宏观风险前瞻性指标的潜力，支持将其纳入新兴经济体的宏观审慎监测框架。

title: Systemic Attrition: The Human, Economic, Legal, and Structural Costs of the 2026 Iran Conflict
affiliations: Independent Policy Analyst

detail.title: Systemic Attrition: The Human, Economic, Legal, and Structural Costs of the 2026 Iran Conflict

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial or personal relationships that could influence the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial or personal relationships that could influence the findings.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
The 2026 Iran conflict generated systemic consequences extending far beyond the direct battlefield, affecting interconnected civilian, logistical, financial, maritime, industrial, and energy systems across multiple regions. Originating in the June 2025 precursor escalation and intensifying with the launch of Operation Epic Fury on 28 February 2026, the conflict evolved into a prolonged geopolitical and macroeconomic disruption marked by infrastructure degradation, maritime instability in the Strait of Hormuz, humanitarian displacement, inflationary pressure, and growing fragmentation within alliance and financial structures.

This paper presents a forensic institutional assessment of the conflict through the lens of international law, infrastructure warfare, casualty forensics, macroeconomic shock transmission, industrial attrition, and monetary fragmentation. It introduces the concepts of “Collateral Friction,” describing cascading civilian harm caused by interconnected infrastructure failure, and the “Industrial Attrition Paradox,” referring to the inability of liberalised peacetime defence-industrial systems to replenish advanced munitions at wartime consumption rates.

The paper argues that the defining characteristic of the conflict was not decisive military transformation, but systemic degradation across energy markets, food systems, shipping corridors, and civilian infrastructure, with disproportionate economic burdens falling on neutral Global South economies. It concludes that the conflict demonstrated the declining ability of kinetic military superiority alone to produce durable strategic outcomes within a deeply interconnected global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文对2026年伊朗冲突进行了法证式制度评估，分析了冲突如何通过基础设施破坏、霍尔木兹海峡动荡、人道主义流离失所、通胀压力以及联盟与金融体系碎片化，产生远超直接战场的系统性后果。论文提出“附带摩擦”和“工业损耗悖论”两个新概念，认为冲突的本质并非决定性军事变革，而是能源、粮食、航运和民用基础设施的系统性退化，且中立全球南方经济体承担了不成比例的经济负担。
AI.research_question: 2026年伊朗冲突如何通过基础设施、经济、金融和联盟体系的互联互通产生系统性、跨区域的非直接战场后果？
AI.motivation: 传统军事分析往往聚焦于战场胜负，但现代冲突在高度互联的全球经济中会产生远超战场的系统性创伤。本文旨在揭示这种被忽视的“系统性后果”，并挑战“纯粹军事优势可产生持久战略成果”的传统假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）“附带摩擦”（Collateral Friction）：描述互联基础设施故障引发的级联平民伤害；2）“工业损耗悖论”（Industrial Attrition Paradox）：描述自由化和平时期的国防工业体系无法以战时消耗速度补充先进弹药。
AI.method: 法证式制度评估（forensic institutional assessment），综合运用国际法分析、基础设施战评估、伤亡法医学、宏观经济冲击传导分析、工业损耗分析以及货币碎片化分析。
AI.findings: 冲突的决定性特征并非决定性军事变革，而是能源市场、食品系统、航运走廊和民用基础设施的系统性退化；中立全球南方经济体承担了不成比例的经济负担；表明纯粹军事优势在深度互联的全球经济中已难以产生持久的战略成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“附带摩擦”和“工业损耗悖论”两个原创性概念，为理解现代混合冲突/系统性冲突提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对国际法、军事战略制定、国防工业体系设计、全球经济风险管理以及全球南方政策应对具有参考价值；挑战了“军事优势=战略成果”的传统认知。

title: AI-driven Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions Screening in Cross-border Remittances for Terrorist Financing Mitigation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI-driven Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions Screening in Cross-border Remittances for Terrorist Financing Mitigation
detail.abstract: Cross-border money transfers are a lifeline for millions of families. But they also offer a quiet path for terrorist financing-that's the dark side. The usual way of watching transactions-looking for amounts above a certain dollar value and manually checking names against sanctions lists-just doesn't catch small, carefully split payments. Plus manual name screening creates so many false alarms that compliance teams drown in noise. I reckon artificial intelligence can fix both problems. This paper proposes a two-part AI system: one part learns normal sending behaviour and spots strange patterns (using autoencoders and graph neural networks), the other matches names against watchlists using fuzzy logic and machine learning to cut false positives by 70-80%. To ground the idea in reality, we examine eight real court cases from Australia, the UK, the US, the Netherlands and Sweden-all convictions where people used Western Union or hawala networks to fund terror groups. In each case, I show how AI could have detected the scheme within hours or days instead of months, and with far fewer false alerts. The framework follows FATF's latest rules (2025) and is practical enough for money transfer operators to start using today.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套双模块AI反恐融资系统，结合异常交易检测（自动编码器+图神经网络）与智能姓名筛查（模糊逻辑+机器学习），可将误报率降低70-80%，并通过8个真实司法案例验证其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能技术有效检测通过跨境小额汇款进行的恐怖主义融资活动，同时大幅减少传统方法中的误报问题？
AI.motivation: 传统反恐融资监控依赖金额阈值和人工名单筛查，对小额拆分付款几乎无效，且人工筛查产生大量误报，导致合规团队不堪重负。亟需更智能、高效的检测方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异常检测理论（自动编码器捕捉偏离正常汇款行为的模式）、图神经网络（建模交易网络中的隐藏关联）、模糊逻辑与机器学习（名称模糊匹配降低误报）。
AI.method: 提出双模块AI框架：（1）异常交易检测模块，使用自动编码器和图神经网络学习正常汇款行为并识别异常模式；（2）智能姓名筛查模块，利用模糊逻辑和机器学习将名称与监控名单匹配，减少70-80%误报。通过8个来自澳大利亚、英国、美国、荷兰、瑞典的真实定罪案例进行回溯验证。
AI.findings: 在8个真实案例中，AI系统能在数小时或数天内检测出原本耗时数月才能发现的恐怖融资活动，且误报数量大幅减少。框架符合FATF 2025最新监管规则，具备即时落地的可操作性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将异常检测、图神经网络与模糊匹配三种AI技术系统性地整合到反恐融资场景，提出了一个可验证、可回溯的检测框架，拓展了AI在金融犯罪防控领域的理论应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汇款机构提供了可直接部署的AI解决方案，可将误报率降低70-80%，大幅减轻合规负担，同时提升对小额拆分恐怖融资的检测效率，并符合最新国际监管标准（FATF 2025）。

title: Optimal recycling of carbon revenues along the net-zero pathway
affiliations: University of Warsaw

detail.title: Optimal recycling of carbon revenues along the net-zero pathway
detail.abstract: Carbon-pricing revenues are temporary; they are substantial during partial decarbonisation and vanish as emissions approach net zero. Recycling these revenues therefore raises two intertemporal questions for governments: whether to return revenues immediately to households or save them for the net-zero phase, and whether financing temporary abatement subsidies from these revenues may distort households' saving and investment decisions. We build an analytical general-equilibrium model to compare three recycling options: immediate lump-sum transfers, public saving to finance future transfers, and abatement subsidies. In a benchmark setup with perfect-foresight households, a single final good, and a closed economy, Ricardian equivalence holds: all three options deliver identical welfare. We show how relaxing benchmark assumptions breaks equivalence. With myopic households, public saving is preferable to immediate transfers when abatement is capital-intensive, policy costs rise over time, or learning-by-doing externalities are present; otherwise, immediate transfers dominate. Financing subsidies lowers welfare: it alters the price of investment relative to consumption, thereby distorting saving decisions. In open economies, it also redistributes resources to foreign capital owners. Simulations of a large-scale computable general equilibrium model calibrated to the Polish economy indicate that public saving outperforms both alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了碳定价收入如何在过渡期和净零期之间最优分配。基准情形下（完美预见、单一最终品、封闭经济），三种回收方式（即时转移、公共储蓄、减排补贴）福利等价。放松假设后，公共储蓄优于即时转移（当减排资本密集、政策成本上升或存在干中学时），补贴则会扭曲储蓄决策。波兰CGE模型模拟显示公共储蓄最优。
AI.research_question: 碳定价收入（在部分脱碳期间大量存在、净零时消失）应如何跨期回收？是立即返还给家庭、储蓄以备净零期使用，还是用于补贴减排行为？这些选择是否会扭曲家庭储蓄和投资决策？
AI.motivation: 碳定价收入具有"临时性"特征——在脱碳进程中规模可观，但随排放趋近净零而消失。这引出了两个关键跨期问题：(1) 政府应即时返还收入还是为净零阶段储蓄？(2) 用这些收入融资临时减排补贴是否会扭曲储蓄/投资决策？现有文献缺乏对此类跨期选择的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 李嘉图等价理论（基准情形下三种回收方式等价）、一般均衡理论（跨期家庭决策、储蓄-投资平衡）、学习效应/干中学理论（减排技术的动态外部性）、开放经济资本流动理论
AI.method: (1) 构建分析性一般均衡模型，设定基准情形（完美预见、单一最终品、封闭经济），推导三种回收方式的等价条件；(2) 逐一放松基准假设（短视家庭、资本密集型减排、政策成本上升、干中学外部性、开放经济），分析等价条件如何被打破；(3) 基于波兰经济数据，进行大规模可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型模拟验证。
AI.findings: (1) 基准情形下（完美预见、单一最终品、封闭经济），三种回收方式李嘉图等价，福利无差异；(2) 放松假设后等价被打破：短视家庭下，若减排资本密集型、政策成本上升或存在干中学外部性，公共储蓄优于即时转移；否则即时转移更优；(3) 补贴降低福利：改变投资相对于消费的价格，扭曲储蓄决策；在开放经济中还向外国资本所有者转移资源；(4) 波兰CGE模拟证实公共储蓄优于其他两种方案。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将李嘉图等价理论拓展至气候政策领域，揭示了碳定价收入跨期分配的理论边界条件；(2) 系统识别了打破等价的关键机制（家庭短视、资本密集度、学习效应），为不同经济体的最优政策选择提供了理论依据；(3) 揭示了补贴方案扭曲储蓄决策的传导机制（改变投资-消费相对价格）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者提供了碳定价收入管理的具体指导：最优方案是公共储蓄（而非即时转移或补贴）；(2) 波兰案例的CGE模拟为转型经济体提供了可参考的实证证据；(3) 指出补贴方案在开放经济中会向外国资本转移资源，具有重要的政策警示意义。

title: When Does Flexibility Create Value in Electricity Markets? An AI-Based Market-State Approach
affiliations: Illinois Institute of Technology and Old Dominion University

detail.title: When Does Flexibility Create Value in Electricity Markets? An AI-Based Market-State Approach
detail.abstract: Electricity-market volatility does not by itself explain when flexibility becomes economically valuable. A central problem in the current literature is that price forecasting, tail-risk measurement, and flexibility valuation are often studied separately, leaving limited evidence on how observed market conditions map into realized flexibility value. This paper addresses that gap by developing an AI-based State-Price Flexibility Index (SPFI) that learns a flexibility-relevant latent market state from hub-level price and trading information. The framework combines a multidimensional state representation, conditional distribution forecasting, scenario construction, and economic valuation. The novelty is threefold. Theoretically, the paper models flexibility value as state-dependent and multidimensional rather than as a direct function of volatility alone. Empirically, it uses a 2014–2025 hub-date panel with 17,219 observations to estimate and validate the index. Economically, it evaluates the learned state by realized flexibility value, downside-risk reduction, and marginal capacity value. The results show that the SPFI identifies economically informative flexibility conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于AI的状态价格灵活性指数（SPFI），通过从电力市场价格和交易信息中学习灵活性相关的潜在市场状态，将价格预测、尾部风险测度和灵活性估值整合在一个统一框架内，解决了当前文献中三者分离的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将市场条件系统地映射到实现的灵活性价值上？即如何构建一个综合性的指标来评估电力市场中灵活性的经济价值？
AI.motivation: 当前文献中存在三个分离的研究领域（价格预测、尾部风险测度、灵活性估值），缺乏对市场条件如何转化为灵活性价值的系统性证据。电力市场波动性本身并不能解释灵活性何时具有经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灵活性价值是状态依赖且多维度的，而非波动率的直接函数。通过潜在市场状态的多维表征来刻画灵活性价值。
AI.method: AI-based方法构建状态价格灵活性指数（SPFI），包含四个步骤：多维状态表征、条件分布预测、情景构建和经济估值。使用2014-2025年中心节点日期面板数据，共17,219个观测值。
AI.findings: SPFI能够识别出具有经济信息含量的灵活性条件，通过实现的灵活性价值、下行风险降低和边际容量价值三个维度进行了验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将灵活性价值建模为状态依赖且多维度的概念，而非传统上将其视为波动率的直接函数，为灵活性定价提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的指标（SPFI），帮助电力市场参与者识别灵活性具有高经济价值的市场条件，从而优化灵活资源的配置和投资决策。

title: Basel III-IV: Ten Structural Failures That Cannot Be Fixed From Within. SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8 as a Complete Architectural Replacement

detail.title: Basel III-IV: Ten Structural Failures That Cannot Be Fixed From Within. SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8 as a Complete Architectural Replacement
detail.abstract: This article is a direct continuation of the first comparative analysis of Basel III-IV and SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7. While the first article established the philosophical and methodological superiority of the real-backing paradigm over the nominal-value paradigm, this second part performs a systematic forensic audit of ten to twelve specific structural vulnerabilities embedded directly in the official BCBS regulatory texts, including supervisory guidance issued between 2021 and 2026. Each vulnerability is identified by the exact document number, section, and paragraph of the Basel Committee. For each failure point, the corresponding mechanism in SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8 is shown to provide a mathematically complete solution. The conclusion is unambiguous: the failures are not accidental gaps that can be patched. They are load-bearing elements of the fiat architecture. Replacing individual rules while preserving the axiom that nominal debt equals real value is impossible. Only a full architectural replacement resolves the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文对巴塞尔协议III-IV与SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8进行了系统性取证审计，识别出10-12个嵌入BCBS官方监管文本中的结构性漏洞，并论证这些漏洞并非偶然缺陷，而是法定货币体系的承重结构，只有完全替换架构才能解决根本问题。
AI.research_question: 巴塞尔协议III-IV的监管框架是否存在系统性结构性漏洞？这些漏洞是偶然缺陷还是法定架构的必然产物？
AI.motivation: 在第一篇文章已论证真实支撑范式在哲学和方法论上优于名义价值范式的基础上，本文进一步通过具体监管文本的取证审计来验证这一结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 真实支撑范式（real-backing paradigm）vs 名义价值范式（nominal-value paradigm）；法定货币体系的结构性分析。
AI.method: 系统性的取证审计（forensic audit），逐一对照BCBS官方文件（2021-2026年间的监管指南）的具体文档编号、章节和段落，识别结构性漏洞，并与SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8的对应机制进行对比。
AI.findings: 识别出10-12个具体的结构性漏洞；每个漏洞都有对应的SVWORLD STANDARD解决方案；这些漏洞并非偶然缺失，而是法定架构中名义债务等同于真实价值这一公理的必要承重结构；局部修补不可行，必须完全替换架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了巴塞尔框架中结构性漏洞的本质属性——不是技术性缺陷而是范式层级的问题；提出"名义债务=真实价值"是法定体系不可动摇的公理；论证了局部改革无法解决根本性范式冲突。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了具体的文档级漏洞定位（文档编号、章节、段落）；提出了SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.8作为完整的替代解决方案；对金融监管改革方向具有警示意义。

title: The Fiscal Architecture of American Decline: Debt, Deficits, and Structural Impossibility

detail.title: The Fiscal Architecture of American Decline: Debt, Deficits, and Structural Impossibility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is not affiliated with any organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author used publicly available information. There were no participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The author funded the research.

detail.abstract: The United States fiscal trajectory is not a policy failure or a partisan choice. It is the structural consequence of an infrastructure transition in which FIRE-dominant economic architecture systematically shifted tax incidence from capital to labor-corporations fell from 31 percent to 9 percent of federal revenue between 1946 and 2023; payroll taxes rose from 8 percent to 36 percent over the same period-while the winning coalition's private-goods benefits expanded and public investment contracted. The result is a fiscal architecture that simultaneously finances the winning coalition's asset positions (federal debt at $28.2 trillion generates $950 billion in annual interest payments, 56 percent of which flows to the Elite and Chamber GOP coalitions) and structurally forecloses the public investment that would address the binding constraints documented in Papers P5 and P6. Federal government productive activities declined from 54 percent of noninterest spending in 1970 to 24 percent in 2023. CBO projects net interest will consume 23 percent of the federal budget by 2054, crowding out every discretionary program. The OASI trust fund depletes around 2033-2034 on current trajectory, at which point Social Security benefits face an automatic 21-23 percent cut-falling most heavily on the MAGA coalition that is the program's largest electoral constituency. The paper introduces binding constraints analysis (Hausmann, Rodrik, and Velasco 2005) at the country level: the U.S. fiscal binding constraint is not excessive spending but a revenue architecture designed to minimize the winning coalition's tax contribution to the public goods it requires. Two registered predictions are examined: P4 (r > g threshold breach by 2031, at which point asset returns systematically exceed GDP growth, accelerating wealth concentration beyond current levels) and P5 (OASI depletion ~2033-2034, with politically definitive benefit cut implications). The closing circle is traced at full resolution: the fiscal architecture suppresses the public investment that would relax the binding constraints that suppress the fertility and labor force growth that would service the debt that the architecture created.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了美国财政轨迹并非政策失败或党派选择，而是FIRE（金融、保险、房地产）主导经济架构转型的结构性结果。该架构将税负从资本转向劳动，同时扩大获胜联盟的私人利益、缩减公共投资，导致财政陷入自我强化的闭锁循环：债务利息支付流向精英群体，公共投资被挤出，约束条件被固化，最终威胁社会保障体系。
AI.research_question: 美国不可持续的财政轨迹的根本原因是什么？它是政策失败、党派选择，还是经济架构转型的结构性结果？
AI.motivation: 现有对美国财政危机的解释多归因于政党政治或政策失误，本文提出更根本的结构性解释：FIRE主导的经济架构系统性地重塑了税收归属与公共支出结构，导致了自我强化的财政闭锁循环。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束条件分析方法（Hausmann, Rodrik, and Velasco 2005）；r > g阈值理论（资产回报率超过经济增长率）；基础设施转型理论（FIRE经济架构取代工业经济架构）；获胜联盟理论。
AI.method: 纵向历史数据分析（1946-2023年联邦税收结构变化）；约束条件识别与验证；注册预测检验（P4：r > g阈值突破；P5：OASI信托基金耗尽）。
AI.findings: (1) 企业税收占比从31%降至9%，薪资税从8%升至36%，税负从资本转向劳动；(2) 联邦债务28.2万亿美元产生年利息9500亿美元，56%流向精英和商会GOP联盟；(3) 联邦政府生产性活动占比从54%降至24%；(4) CBO预测利息支出2054年占预算23%；(5) OASI基金2033-2034年耗尽，社保将自动削减21-23%，最重打击MAGA联盟。
AI.theory_contributions: 将约束条件分析方法从发展中国家应用到美国财政分析；提出"财政架构内生性地抑制解决自身所需公共投资"的闭锁循环理论；将r > g阈值与政治联盟利益分配联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国财政改革提供结构性诊断：核心问题不是支出过多，而是税收架构设计旨在最小化获胜联盟对公共品的税收贡献；预警社保削减将对其最大选举支持群体（MAGA联盟）造成最严重打击。

title: Model Predictive Control-Based Optimal Energy Allocation for Generalized Energy Storage Systems Considering Dynamic Variations of SOC and SOH
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Model Predictive Control-Based Optimal Energy Allocation for Generalized Energy Storage Systems Considering Dynamic Variations of SOC and SOH
detail.abstract: To address the issues of high system volatility and insufficient regulation capability under high penetration of wind and photovoltaic (PV) powers, a generalized energy storage system (GESS) is constructed, including wind power, PV, hydrogen energy storage, battery energy storage, and flexible loads. First, a GESS state-space model is established based on model predictive control (MPC) theory. An optimization objective is formulated by comprehensively considering the power constraints of each unit and the state constraints of the energy storage devices, thereby maintaining system power balance and realizing the optimal operation of the GESS. Second, to prevent violations of the state of charge (SOC) and state of hydrogen (SOH) limits, as well as to mitigate the safety and lifetime problems caused by the low-power operation of the electrolyzer and fuel cell, a multi-unit power coordination strategy based on the dynamic variations in SOC and SOH is proposed to optimize energy allocation within the system. Finally, experiments are carried out on the RT-LAB platform. Under operating conditions where storage the SOC limits are exceeded, the fixed-weight strategy and the variable-weight strategy are compared, and the results demonstrate the superior dynamic regulation performance of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 针对高风电/光伏渗透率下系统波动大、调节能力不足的问题，构建了包含多种储能和灵活负荷的广义储能系统（GESS），基于模型预测控制建立状态空间模型，并提出基于SOC/SOH动态变化的多单元功率协调策略，在RT-LAB平台验证了该方法的优越动态调节性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在高比例风电和光伏并网场景下，通过广义储能系统的优化协调控制来降低系统波动性并提升调节能力？
AI.motivation: 高比例风电和光伏并网导致系统波动性大、调节能力不足，传统储能控制策略难以有效应对储能设备SOC/SOH越限及电解槽/燃料电池低功率运行带来的安全和寿命问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模型预测控制（MPC）理论；广义储能系统（GESS）状态空间模型；基于荷电状态（SOC）和氢状态（SOH）动态变化的功率协调策略。
AI.method: 基于MPC理论建立GESS状态空间模型，综合考虑各单元功率约束和储能设备状态约束构建优化目标；提出基于SOC和SOH动态变化的多单元功率协调策略；在RT-LAB半实物仿真平台进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 在储能SOC越限工况下，与固定权重策略和变权重策略相比，所提出的基于SOC/SOH动态变化的多单元功率协调策略具有更优的动态调节性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MPC理论与储能系统状态动态变化相结合，构建了广义储能系统的状态空间模型和优化框架，提出了基于SOC/SOH动态变化的多单元功率协调方法，拓展了高比例可再生能源场景下储能系统的控制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风电/光伏渗透率场景下的储能系统协调控制提供了可行方案，能够有效防止SOC/SOH越限并缓解电解槽和燃料电池低功率运行带来的安全和寿命问题，提升了系统运行的可靠性和经济性。

title: XTIFN: Grating-based X-Ray Tri-contrast CT Image Fusion via Unsupervised Feature Learning
affiliations: Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA), Beijing Institute of Aeronautical Materials, Aerospace Research Institute of Materials & Processing Technology, Beihang University (BUAA), Beihang University (BUAA) and Beihang University (BUAA)

detail.title: XTIFN: Grating-based X-Ray Tri-contrast CT Image Fusion via Unsupervised Feature Learning
detail.abstract: Grating-based X-ray tri-contrast imaging can acquire absorption, phase-contrast, and dark-field images in a single scan. However, biomedical analysis often still requires repeated switching among separate contrast volumes. A key challenge is to generate one fused CT image that preserves complementary information from different channels, which may have different intensity ranges, spatial details, and noise patterns. In this study, we propose XTIFN, a one-step unsupervised framework for tri-contrast CT image fusion. XTIFN uses a dual-path generator and a tri-discriminator constraint to integrate structural, edge, and texture information from the three input contrasts. In addition, we introduce an independent entropy-weighted multi-source evaluation strategy to assess the contribution of different source contrasts in the fused image. Experiments on synchrotron-radiation and laboratory tube-source datasets achieved entropy-weighted SSIM values of 0.6731 and 0.6542, respectively. The results were further supported by 3D visualization and a human-tissue case study. This work may provide an additional reference view for the joint inspection and visualization of tri-contrast CT data, rather than replacing the original contrast channels, and may help support the broader application of X-ray multi-contrast imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XTIFN，一种无监督的三对比CT图像融合框架，通过双路径生成器和三判别器约束，有效整合吸收、相位对比和暗场图像的互补信息，实验结果显示较好的融合质量。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个无监督框架下，将三对比X射线CT图像（吸收、相位对比、暗场）融合为一张保留互补信息的单一体积图像？
AI.motivation: 三对比X射线成像虽能一次扫描获取三种图像，但生物医学分析仍需频繁切换不同对比通道，缺乏一种能保留各通道互补信息（不同强度范围、空间细节和噪声模式）的统一融合方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成对抗网络（GAN）框架；双路径生成器结构；三判别器约束机制；熵权多源评估策略。
AI.method: 提出XTIFN（X-ray Tri-Image Fusion Network），采用无监督学习方式，包含双路径生成器以整合结构、边缘和纹理信息，以及三判别器约束来对抗训练；引入独立熵权多源评估策略衡量各对比通道贡献。
AI.findings: 在同步辐射和实验室管源数据集上，熵权SSIM值分别达到0.6731和0.6542；3D可视化和人体组织案例研究进一步验证了融合效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个无监督的三对比CT图像融合框架XTIFN，设计了双路径生成器和三判别器结构来同时整合三种对比信息，并引入熵权评估策略为多源图像融合提供新评价思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为三对比CT数据的联合检查和可视化提供了辅助参考视图，有助于推动X射线多对比成像在生物医学领域的更广泛应用，减少临床诊断中反复切换不同对比图像的负担。

title: Customer-Facing Offer Design for Mixed Drone-Courier Delivery: Pricing, Promised Times, and Customer Choice
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Customer-Facing Offer Design for Mixed Drone-Courier Delivery: Pricing, Promised Times, and Customer Choice
detail.abstract: This paper studies how an on-demand delivery platform should design customer-facing offers in mixed drone-courier operations. For each new order, the platform decides which service products to display and what prices and promised delivery times to set for rider-only, drone-assisted, and flexible products. Customers then self-select, and the resulting demand mix feeds back into future service conditions. We develop a sequential framework that links offer-design decisions, multinomial-logit customer choice, and fulfillment outcomes through a tractable mode-level surrogate for cost, realized service time, and lateness penalties. Computational experiments compare a transparent dynamic-menu heuristic that jointly adjusts visibility, price, and promised time, a stronger one-step optimized comparator used asa diagnostic benchmark, a price+time variant without visibility control, and dispatch-only and static-menu reference regimes. Across the reported synthetic scenario families, pricing and promised-time adaptation prove to be the primary levers for balancing profit and reliability. By contrast, the additional value brought by visibility control is conditional within the tested heuristic family and can be neutral or slightly negative in some scenarios. The benchmark comparison also reveals substantial performance headroom, showing that the framework is most useful for identifying which customer-facing levers matter and for clarifying how benchmark strength affects the interpretation of lightweight deployable rules. Overall, the paper provides directional evidence on transport service management under stylized conditions rather than direct deployment prescriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究按需配送平台在无人机与骑手混合运营中，如何设计面向客户的展示方案（包括服务产品可见性、定价和承诺送达时间），以平衡利润和服务可靠性。
AI.research_question: 在无人机-骑手混合配送模式下，按需配送平台应如何设计面向客户的服务产品展示策略（包括产品可见性、定价和承诺送达时间），以优化利润和服务可靠性？
AI.motivation: 无人机与骑手混合运营日益普及，但平台如何在动态环境中同时优化展示哪些服务、定价多少以及承诺多快送达，尚无系统性的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序列决策框架——将报价设计（visibility, price, promised time）、多项式Logit客户自选择模型与履约结果（成本、实际服务时间、延迟惩罚）相链接；以模式级替代变量简化履约复杂性。
AI.method: 基于合成数据的计算实验，比较五种策略：动态菜单启发式（联合调整可见性、价格和承诺时间）、一步优化基准、仅价格+时间（无可见性控制）、仅调度、静态菜单。
AI.findings: （1）定价和承诺时间调整是平衡利润与可靠性的主要杠杆；（2）可见性控制的附加价值在测试的启发式中是有条件的，在某些场景中中性甚至轻微负面；（3）存在显著的绩效改进空间，框架最有助于识别哪些客户面向杠杆真正重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 为混合无人机-骑手配送的报价设计提供了第一个系统性的序列决策分析框架；揭示了不同客户面向杠杆（价格、时间、可见性）的相对重要性及其条件性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为按需配送平台提供了设计客户展示策略的指导方向：优先关注定价和承诺时间的动态调整，而非盲目追求产品可见性控制；澄清了轻量级可部署规则与理论最优基准之间的差距。

title: Rethinking Ecological Economics
affiliations: Norwegian University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Rethinking Ecological Economics
detail.abstract: Despite important successes, ecological economics remains a highly heterogeneous field, characterized by divergent views on what constitutes economics, its philosophical foundations, and the understanding of markets and human action. This internal diversity weakens its ability to function as a clear alternative to neoclassical economics and to fulfill its central purpose of providing a scholarly basis for the transformation toward a sustainable economy. This paper develops a coherent vision of ecological economics by articulating an explicit ethical framework and a distinct definition of what economics is. It argues that critical realism provides the most appropriate philosophical foundation and advances a conception of the economy as embedded in biophysical systems as well as social and political institutions. Rejecting neoclassical models of rationality and behavior, it is argued that ecological economics should develop on the basis of an institutional understanding of human action. It concludes by demonstrating how this rethought ecological economics enables stronger analytical contributions and more productive engagement with dialogues about how a sustainable future might be realized.
